values.note: Forest Service banner: 'Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires. Drinking water is currently unavailable at this campground.' No reopening date posted (page last updated August 28, 2026; no matching closure order is listed on the forest's alerts page).

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/boulder-creek-campground (Current Conditions: 'Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires. Drinking water is currently unavailable at this campground.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open annually from mid-May through September, weather dependent.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/boulder-creek-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open annually from mid-May through September, weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 3 of the 13 sites are pull-through; 30 ft is the maximum recommended trailer length.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/boulder-creek-campground ('3 of the 13 sites are pull-through sites that are easier for campers and trailers. The maximum recommended length for trailers at this site is 30' feet'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Fire rings, picnic tables, vault toilets and a water pump, but no garbage service (pack it out). Water is 'currently unavailable'; the forest suggests calling the Wise River Work Center to check the pump before relying on it.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/boulder-creek-campground ('Fire rings, picnic tables, vault toilets, and water are available at this site, however garbage services are not'; 'we recommend calling ahead to the Wise River Work Center to check the conditions of the water pump'; Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $5 a night for each additional vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/boulder-creek-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night'; 'There is a $15 per-night fee for camping, with a $5 additional fee for extra vehicles.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wisdom RD), high-elevation, heavily wooded campground along the paved Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway (FS Road 73), ~13 mi south of MT-43 near Wise River. --Claude
